title: Risk Notes section should identify all high-fan-out bottleneck features, not just ML services
description: Phase 2 Risk Notes only flagged Scribe ML service, but SD-1 (Advanced Search Panel) is also a high-fan-out bottleneck with 5+ direct dependents (SD-9, SD-10, SD-13, SD-14, AM-4) plus their downstream chains. SD-1 itself depends on IP-13 (end of pipeline chain). If SD-1's complex query builder implementation is delayed, it blocks the entire search and alert filter subsystem. Risk Notes should systematically identify all features with 5+ downstream dependents in the same phase.
root_cause: The manifest generation step (Phase 3.3) adds Risk Notes based on domain-specific heuristics (e.g., ML services are risky) rather than systematically analyzing the in-phase dependency DAG for high-fan-out nodes.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3, after computing the per-phase feature table, analyze the in-phase dependency DAG and identify all features with 5+ downstream dependents in the same phase. For each, add a Risk Note with: (1) the feature ID and name, (2) the number of downstream dependents, (3) recommended mitigations (stub/mock strategies, early prototyping). Apply to both technical risk (ML, complex DSLs) and schedule risk (high fan-out).
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Risk Notes section
